  - url: https://eligibility.epd2.example
    description: eligibility-service (not deployed in PACK-07 — contract only)
  - url: https://membership.epd2.example
    description: membership-service (not deployed in PACK-07 — contract only)

paths:
  # ==========================================================================
  # eligibility-service — ParticipantEligibilityPolicy (canon 19d.4)
  # ==========================================================================
  /participant-eligibility-policies:
    post:
      operationId: proposeParticipantEligibilityPolicy
      summary: Create a new draft ParticipantEligibilityPolicy version
      description: >
        Owned by eligibility-service. Maps to
        epd2_eligibility_service.application.propose_participant_eligibility_policy.
        No canonical event — activation, not proposal, is the audited,
        critical action.
      tags: [eligibility-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [policy_id, policy_version, adopted_by_decision_id]
              properties:
                policy_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                policy_version: { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
                scope_type: { type: ["string", "null"] }
                scope_id: { type: ["string", "null"], format: uuid }
                effective_from: { type: ["string", "null"], format: date-time }
                effective_until: { type: ["string", "null"], format: date-time }
                adopted_by_decision_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                signed_policy_digest_reference: { type: ["string", "null"] }
                transparency_log_commitment_reference:
                  { type: ["string", "null"] }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: ParticipantEligibilityPolicy created in draft status

  /participant-eligibility-policies/{policyId}/activate:
    post:
      operationId: activateParticipantEligibilityPolicy
      summary: Activate a draft ParticipantEligibilityPolicy (canon 19d.7 four-gate rule)
      description: >
        Owned by eligibility-service. Maps to
        epd2_eligibility_service.application.activate_participant_eligibility_policy.
        Fail-closed on any of the four activation gates.
      tags: [eligibility-service]
      parameters:
        - name: policyId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: ParticipantEligibilityPolicy transitioned to active
        "403":
          description: One or more activation gates failed (CRITICAL_POLICY_ACTIVATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED)

  # ==========================================================================
  # eligibility-service — ProcessEligibilityPolicy (canon 19d.5)
  # ==========================================================================
  /process-eligibility-policies:
    post:
      operationId: proposeProcessEligibilityPolicy
      summary: Create a new draft ProcessEligibilityPolicy version
      description: >
        Owned by eligibility-service. Maps to
        epd2_eligibility_service.application.propose_process_eligibility_policy.
      tags: [eligibility-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  policy_id,
                  policy_version,
                  process_type,
                  jurisdiction,
                  scope_type,
                  scope_id,
                  adopted_by,
                ]
              properties:
                policy_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                policy_version: { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
                process_type: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                jurisdiction: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                scope_type: { type: ["string", "null"] }
                scope_id: { type: ["string", "null"], format: uuid }
                adopted_by: { type: string, format: uuid }
                eligible_citizenship_set:
                  type: array
                  items: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                minimum_age: { type: ["integer", "null"], minimum: 0 }
                effective_from: { type: ["string", "null"], format: date-time }
                effective_until: { type: ["string", "null"], format: date-time }
                legal_basis: { type: ["string", "null"] }
                decision_effect:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    [
                      advisory,
                      politically_binding,
                      internally_binding,
                      legally_final,
                      requires_formal_confirmation,
                    ]
                formal_confirmation_required: { type: boolean }
                formal_confirmation_authority: { type: ["string", "null"] }
                secret_ballot_required: { type: boolean }
                accessibility_profile: { type: ["string", "null"] }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: ProcessEligibilityPolicy created in draft status

  /process-eligibility-policies/{policyId}/activate:
    post:
      operationId: activateProcessEligibilityPolicy
      summary: Activate a draft ProcessEligibilityPolicy (canon 19d.7 four-gate rule)
      description: >
        Owned by eligibility-service. Maps to
        epd2_eligibility_service.application.activate_process_eligibility_policy.
      tags: [eligibility-service]
      parameters:
        - name: policyId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: ProcessEligibilityPolicy transitioned to active
        "403":
          description: One or more activation gates failed

  /process-eligibility-policies/resolve:
    get:
      operationId: resolveProcessEligibilityPolicy
      summary: Resolve the single applicable ProcessEligibilityPolicy version (ADR-030 item 6)
      description: >
        Owned by eligibility-service. Maps to
        epd2_eligibility_service.application.resolve_process_eligibility_policy.
        Plain, unaudited read. Historical reproducibility depends on the
        caller recording the returned policy_version, never re-resolving
        against a later version.
      tags: [eligibility-service]
      parameters:
        - name: process_type
          in: query
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
        - name: jurisdiction
          in: query
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
        - name: scope_type
          in: query
          required: false
          schema: { type: string }
        - name: scope_id
          in: query
          required: false
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
        - name: effective_date
          in: query
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: date-time }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The single applicable active ProcessEligibilityPolicy, or null if none resolves

  /step-up-authentication/verify:
    post:
      operationId: authenticateStepUpForAction
      summary: Verify an observed authentication state against the active step-up requirement for an action
      description: >
        Owned by eligibility-service. Maps to
        epd2_eligibility_service.application.authenticate_step_up_for_action.
        Fail-closed, including when no active requirement resolves.
      tags: [eligibility-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [action_code, evaluated_at]
              properties:
                action_code: { type: string }
                identity_assurance_level: { type: ["string", "null"] }
                authentication_assurance_level: { type: ["string", "null"] }
                session_authenticated_at:
                  { type: ["string", "null"], format: date-time }
                attribute_verified_at:
                  { type: ["string", "null"], format: date-time }
                evaluated_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Step-up requirement satisfied
        "403":
          description: STEP_UP_AUTHENTICATION_NOT_SATISFIED

              properties:
                claim_met: { type: boolean }
                denial_reason_code: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: AtomicCapabilityResult

  /process-eligibility/scoped-capability-tokens:
    post:
      operationId: deriveAndIssueScopedCapabilityToken
      summary: Derive participation rights for one action and, if authorized, issue a scoped capability token
      description: >
        Owned by eligibility-service. Maps to
        epd2_eligibility_service.application.derive_and_issue_scoped_capability_token.
        Always emits ParticipationRightsDerived, whether or not a token was
        actually issued. Never persists or exposes a

      tags: [eligibility-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  subject_reference,
                  process_id,
                  action_code,
                  claim_met,
                  denial_reason_code,
                  credential_id,
                  credential_type,
                  scope_type,
                  scope_id,
                  valid_from,
                  expires_at,
                  applicable_policy_version,
                ]
              properties:
                subject_reference: { type: string, format: uuid }
                process_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                action_code: { type: string }
                claim_met: { type: boolean }
                denial_reason_code: { type: string }
                credential_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                credential_type:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    [
                      space_access,
                      initiative_support,
                      ballot_access,
                      delegation_access,
                      audit_access,
                    ]
                scope_type: { type: string }
                scope_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                valid_from: { type: string, format: date-time }
                expires_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
                usage_limit: { type: ["integer", "null"], minimum: 1 }
                applicable_policy_version: { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: ParticipationRightsDerived, with an issued credential_id if authorized

  /assembly-decisions/{assemblyDecisionId}/decide:
    post:
      operationId: recordAssemblyDecision
      summary: Record the confirming authority's decision on a pending AssemblyDecision
      description: >
        Owned by eligibility-service. Maps to
        epd2_eligibility_service.application.record_assembly_decision.
        A final_legal_decision diverging from the originating digital_result
        requires a non-empty divergence_explanation.
      tags: [eligibility-service]
      parameters:
        - name: assemblyDecisionId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [new_status, final_legal_decision]
              properties:
                new_status:
                  type: string
                  enum: [confirmed, rejected, returned_for_revision]
                final_legal_decision: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                divergence_explanation: { type: ["string", "null"] }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: AssemblyDecision resolved
        "422":
          description: ASSEMBLY_DECISION_DIVERGENCE_EXPLANATION_REQUIRED

  # ==========================================================================
  # eligibility-service — process eligibility evaluation (canon 19d.3, ADR-027)
  # ==========================================================================
  /process-eligibility/evaluate:
    post:
      operationId: evaluateProcessEligibility
      summary: Evaluate a subject's four separated electoral-eligibility claims for one process
      description: >
        Owned by eligibility-service. Maps to
        epd2_eligibility_service.application.evaluate_process_eligibility.
        Resolves the single applicable ProcessEligibilityPolicy version,
        reads identity-service and (where relevant) membership-service's
        narrow ADR-027 claims internally. Never a generic
        electoral_eligibility_met field - always the four separated claims
        (canon 19d.3). Returns null (fail-closed) when no applicable policy
        resolves.
      tags: [eligibility-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  subject_reference,
                  identity_record_id,
                  process_id,
                  process_type,
                  jurisdiction,
                  effective_date,
                ]
              properties:
                subject_reference: { type: string, format: uuid }
                identity_record_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                process_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                process_type: { type: string }
                jurisdiction: { type: string }
                scope_type: { type: ["string", "null"] }
                scope_id: { type: ["string", "null"], format: uuid }
                effective_date: { type: string, format: date-time }
                membership_subject_reference:
                  { type: ["string", "null"], format: uuid }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: ProcessEligibilityClaims plus applicable_policy_version, or null

openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: EPD² Civic OS — CLAUDE-PACK-08 service contracts
  version: "0.1.0"
  description: >
    Transport-neutral API contract for the one PACK-08 service
    (organization-service, canon-0.7.0 section 19e; ADR-032 through
    ADR-037). No production HTTP server ships in this pack — these
    paths document, one-to-one, a deliberately minimal subset of real
    command/query functions in epd2_organization_service.application,
    and are exercised in tests via those application-layer functions
    directly, not over HTTP. Every path maps to exactly one real
    function; none of this file's paths invent an HTTP surface a
    function does not already provide.

    Per task section 19's own "minimal reference APIs only" instruction,
    this file documents exactly the nine operation shapes that section
    lists — create organization; read current/historical organization;
    create/end relation; query relationship graph; assign/revoke
    authority; check regional capability; list scoped authority
    assignments; read current/historical CivicSpace; inspect effective
    scope — and nothing beyond them. In particular, organization
    lifecycle-transition commands (activate/suspend/dissolve/merge/
    split/declare_successor) and OrganizationalUnit management exist in
    the application layer but are deliberately NOT exposed as their own
    HTTP paths in this minimal reference contract; a future
    implementation pack may add them, additively, under its own review.
    This mirrors PACK-05's own precedent of omitting its bootstrap-seed
    command from its OpenAPI contract by deliberate design, not
    oversight.

    Request bodies list only genuine business fields — actor identity,
    authorization, correlation/causation ids, the clock, and the
    idempotency event_id are transport/session concerns, the same
    convention every earlier pack's own OpenAPI contract already
    follows.

    Per task section 19's own rules: no bulk cross-regional directory
    endpoint and no public member directory exist in this file (there is
    no "list all organizations"/"list all authority holders across
    scopes" path at all); every authorization-consequential path is
    described as evaluated server-side, never trusting frontend input;
    checkRegionalCapability is the one atomic capability check this
    contract exposes, returning only the minimal
    RegionalScopeAccessDecision shape (canon 19e.12/section 22) — never
    any broader identity or membership data.

    server ships in this pack — these paths document, one-to-one, a
    deliberately minimal subset of real command/query functions in
    epd2_compliance_service.application, and are exercised in tests via
    those application-layer functions directly, not over HTTP. Every path
    maps to exactly one real function; none of this file's paths invent an
    HTTP surface a function does not already provide. This mirrors the
    convention every earlier pack's own OpenAPI contract follows.

    Request bodies list only genuine business fields — actor identity,
    the caller's organizational scope, presented cross-scope authority
    references, correlation/causation ids, the clock, and the idempotency
    event_id are transport/session concerns carried outside the body, the
    same convention pack-02.yaml through pack-08.yaml already use.

    Scope rules this contract makes explicit, because they are the
    difference between an ordinary CRUD API and a governed one:

    * Every path is evaluated against the CALLER'S OWN organizational
      scope, resolved server-side and never trusted from the request body.
    * A resource id belonging to another organization returns 404 with
      VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND — deliberately identical to a resource
      that does not exist, so a foreign id cannot be used to probe for
      existence. The specific 403 CROSS_ORGANIZATION_CASE_ACCESS_DENIED /
      CROSS_SCOPE_AUTHORITY_INVALID responses are reachable only by a
      caller that already presented cross-scope authority.
    * There is NO hierarchy-derived inheritance. A Bund-level caller
      holds nothing over a Landesverband's cases, and a Kreisverband
      nothing over its parent Land's, without a CrossScopeAuthorityGrant
      issued by the organization being reached into.
    * There is NO delete path for any governed record anywhere in this
      file. Destruction is a three-step governed workflow
      (evaluate → authorize → execute) that produces immutable evidence
      and leaves the record's metadata row in place.
    * Every timestamp in every request and response is a timezone-aware
      RFC 3339 / ISO-8601 string with an explicit offset, and every
      deadline additionally carries an explicit IANA timezone name.
    * No path accepts or returns an identity attribute, an eID/KYC
      payload, an authentication secret, a document or its bytes, or any
      ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference.

    This contract makes no claim of automatic legal compliance with the
    GDPR, the BDSG or the Parteiengesetz. It documents a governed
    workflow, evidence references and auditability; every legal
    determination stays a human judgement made outside this system.

paths:
  /retention-policies:
    post:
      operationId: registerRetentionPolicy
      summary: Register a retention policy version
      description: >
        Owned by compliance-service. Maps to
        epd2_compliance_service.application.register_retention_policy.
        Registers one (policy_id, policy_version) pair inside the caller's
        own organization. Versions are append-only: re-registering the
        same pair with different content is refused with
        RETENTION_POLICY_VERSION_CONFLICT, and an identical
        re-registration is an idempotent no-op.
      tags: [compliance-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  policy_id,
                  record_class,
                  trigger,
                  retention_days,
                  disposition_action,
                  policy_version,
                  valid_from,
                ]
              properties:
                policy_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                record_class: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                trigger:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    [
                      created_at,
                      case_closed_at,
                      membership_ended_at,
                      contract_ended_at,
                      processing_ended_at,
                    ]
                retention_days: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
                disposition_action:
                  type: string
                  enum: [delete, anonymize, archive, review]
                policy_version: { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
                valid_from: { type: string, format: date-time }
                valid_until: { type: [string, null], format: date-time }
                authorizing_decision_reference:
                  { type: [string, null], format: uuid }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Retention policy version registered
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "../schemas/retention-policy.schema.json"
        "403":
          description: >-
            Denied with a stable reason code: CROSS_ORGANIZATION_CASE_ACCESS_DENIED
            (the write crossed an organizational boundary without authority),
            CROSS_SCOPE_AUTHORITY_INVALID (a grant was presented but does not
            permit this capability here), ORGANIZATION_SCOPE_UNDETERMINED (the
            caller has no resolvable scope — fail closed) or PERMISSION_DENIED.
        "409":
          description: RETENTION_POLICY_VERSION_CONFLICT — this version already exists with different content

  /retention-policies/{policy_id}/versions:
    post:
      operationId: supersedeRetentionPolicy
      summary: Supersede a retention policy with a newer version
      description: >
        Owned by compliance-service. Maps to
        epd2_compliance_service.application.supersede_retention_policy.
        Registers a newer version AND rebinds every affected governed
        record to it, resetting each record's state to active and dropping
        any standing destruction authorization. This is the executable
        half of the no-policy-rewrite-bypasses-retention rule: changing a
        retention schedule never, by itself, authorizes destruction of
        already-governed records — a fresh eligibility evaluation and a
        fresh authorization are always required afterwards, and any active
        Legal Hold keeps blocking regardless.
      tags: [compliance-service]
      parameters:
        - name: policy_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
          description: The policy being superseded.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                [
                  policy_version,
                  supersedes_policy_version,
                  record_class,
                  trigger,
                  retention_days,
                  disposition_action,
                  valid_from,
                ]
              properties:
                policy_version: { type: integer, minimum: 2 }
                supersedes_policy_version: { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
                record_class: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                trigger:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    [
                      created_at,
                      case_closed_at,
                      membership_ended_at,
                      contract_ended_at,
                      processing_ended_at,
                    ]
                retention_days: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
                disposition_action:
                  type: string
                  enum: [delete, anonymize, archive, review]
                valid_from: { type: string, format: date-time }
                valid_until: { type: [string, null], format: date-time }
                authorizing_decision_reference:
                  { type: [string, null], format: uuid }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: >-
            New policy version registered; every rebound governed record is
            returned so the caller can see exactly which authorizations were
            invalidated.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                additionalProperties: false
                required: [policy, rebound_records]
                properties:
                  policy:
                    $ref: "../schemas/retention-policy.schema.json"
                  rebound_records:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: "../schemas/governed-record.schema.json"
        "403":
          description: >-
            Denied with a stable reason code: CROSS_ORGANIZATION_CASE_ACCESS_DENIED
            (the write crossed an organizational boundary without authority),
            CROSS_SCOPE_AUTHORITY_INVALID (a grant was presented but does not
            permit this capability here), ORGANIZATION_SCOPE_UNDETERMINED (the
            caller has no resolvable scope — fail closed) or PERMISSION_DENIED.
        "404":
          description: >-
            VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND. Returned identically whether the
            resource does not exist or exists in another organization and no
            cross-scope authority was presented, so a foreign id discloses
            nothing.

  /governed-records/{record_id}/disposal-eligibility:
    get:
      operationId: evaluateDisposalEligibility
      summary: Deterministically evaluate whether a record may be disposed of
      description: >
        Owned by compliance-service. Maps to
        epd2_compliance_service.application.evaluate_disposal_eligibility.
        A read-only evaluation whose refusal order is fixed and
        observable: unresolved scope, unknown record, unknown policy
        version, indeterminate hold state, unknown retention start, active
        Legal Hold, then the due-time check. An indeterminate hold state
        is a 409 LEGAL_HOLD_STATE_UNKNOWN rather than an ineligible
        verdict, because 'we could not determine the hold state' is a
        different fact from 'this record is not yet eligible'.
      tags: [compliance-service]
      parameters:
        - name: record_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
          description: The governed record being evaluated.
      responses:
        "200":
          description: >-
            Deterministic eligibility verdict. An ineligible verdict always
            carries the reason code that produced it
            (RETENTION_DISPOSITION_NOT_DUE, RETENTION_START_UNDETERMINED or
            RECORD_UNDER_LEGAL_HOLD) plus, for a hold, the blocking hold ids.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                additionalProperties: false
                required:
                  [
                    record_id,
                    organization_id,
                    evaluated_at,
                    retention_policy_id,
                    retention_policy_version,
                    due_at,
                    eligible,
                    reason_code,
                    blocking_hold_ids,
                  ]
                properties:
                  record_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                  organization_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                  evaluated_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
                  retention_policy_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                  retention_policy_version: { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
                  due_at: { type: [string, null], format: date-time }
                  eligible: { type: boolean }
                  reason_code: { type: [string, null] }
                  blocking_hold_ids:
                    type: array
                    items: { type: string, format: uuid }
        "403":
          description: >-
            Denied with a stable reason code: CROSS_ORGANIZATION_CASE_ACCESS_DENIED
            (the write crossed an organizational boundary without authority),
            CROSS_SCOPE_AUTHORITY_INVALID (a grant was presented but does not
            permit this capability here), ORGANIZATION_SCOPE_UNDETERMINED (the
            caller has no resolvable scope — fail closed) or PERMISSION_DENIED.
        "404":
          description: >-
            VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND. Returned identically whether the
            resource does not exist or exists in another organization and no
            cross-scope authority was presented, so a foreign id discloses
            nothing.
        "409":
          description: >-
            LEGAL_HOLD_STATE_UNKNOWN — at least one applicable hold is in the
            indeterminate state, so eligibility cannot be assessed and the
            operation fails closed.

  /governed-records/{record_id}/destruction-authorizations:
    post:
      operationId: authorizeDestruction
      summary: Issue the separate authorization a destruction requires
      description: >
        Owned by compliance-service. Maps to
        epd2_compliance_service.application.authorize_destruction. Re-runs
        the full eligibility evaluation itself rather than trusting a
        caller-supplied verdict, so a hold placed between evaluation and
        authorization still blocks. The resulting authorization is bound
        to the exact policy version and record version it was issued
        against.
      tags: [compliance-service]
      parameters:
        - name: record_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
          description: The governed record being authorized for disposal.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [authorized_by_authority_reference]
              properties:
                authorized_by_authority_reference:
                  { type: string, format: uuid }
                expected_record_version: { type: [integer, null], minimum: 1 }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Destruction authorized
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "../schemas/governed-record.schema.json"
        "403":
          description: >-
            RECORD_UNDER_LEGAL_HOLD (an active hold applies — this always wins
            over retention state), LEGAL_HOLD_STATE_UNKNOWN (fail closed), or
            one of the scope codes listed on the other paths.
        "409":
          description: >-
            RETENTION_DISPOSITION_NOT_DUE, RETENTION_START_UNDETERMINED,
            OPTIMISTIC_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT or COMPLIANCE_COMMAND_CONFLICT.
        "404":
          description: >-
            VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND. Returned identically whether the
            resource does not exist or exists in another organization and no
            cross-scope authority was presented, so a foreign id discloses
            nothing.

  /governed-records/{record_id}/destruction:
    post:
      operationId: executeDestruction
      summary: Execute an authorized destruction and produce immutable evidence
      description: >
        Owned by compliance-service. Maps to
        epd2_compliance_service.application.execute_destruction. This is
        the ONLY way a governed record reaches the destroyed state; there
        is deliberately no DELETE method on any governed-record path in
        this contract, and the service's storage layer exposes no delete
        operation at all. Legal Hold is re-checked here, at execution
        time, so a hold placed after authorization still blocks. Evidence
        is created exactly once per record; a retried call with the same
        event_id returns the existing evidence untouched. The record's
        metadata row survives with state=destroyed and its evidence
        reference attached.
      tags: [compliance-service]
      parameters:
        - name: record_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
          description: The governed record being destroyed.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [executed_by_authority_reference, evidence_digest]
              properties:
                executed_by_authority_reference: { type: string, format: uuid }
                evidence_digest: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Destruction executed; immutable evidence recorded
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                additionalProperties: false
                required: [record, evidence]
                properties:
                  record:
                    $ref: "../schemas/governed-record.schema.json"
                  evidence:
                    $ref: "../schemas/destruction-evidence.schema.json"
        "403":
          description: >-
            RECORD_UNDER_LEGAL_HOLD, LEGAL_HOLD_STATE_UNKNOWN, or a scope code.
        "409":
          description: >-
            DESTRUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED (no authorization exists — a
            governed record is never removed by an ordinary delete),
            DESTRUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_STALE (the authorization predates a policy
            supersession or record change) or DESTRUCTION_ALREADY_EXECUTED.
        "404":
          description: >-
            VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND. Returned identically whether the
            resource does not exist or exists in another organization and no
            cross-scope authority was presented, so a foreign id discloses
            nothing.

  /processing-activities:
    post:
      operationId: registerProcessingActivity
      summary: Register a Processing Registry entry
      description: >
        Owned by compliance-service. Maps to
        epd2_compliance_service.application.register_processing_activity.
        Everything recorded is categorical — categories of data, of data
        subjects, of recipients — and no individual data subject is ever
        named. legal_basis is a managed classification drawn from a closed
        list; recording it asserts nothing about legal sufficiency. The

                  technical_organizational_measures,
                  controller_reference,
                  process_owner_authority_reference,
                  system_references,
                  status,
                  valid_from,
                ]
              properties:
                activity_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                name: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                purpose: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                legal_basis:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    [
                      consent,
                      contract,
                      legal_obligation,
                      vital_interests,
                      public_task,
                      legitimate_interests,
                      party_statute,
                      other_documented,
                    ]
                data_subject_categories:
                  type: array
                  minItems: 1
                  items: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                personal_data_categories:
                  type: array
                  minItems: 1
                  items: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                recipient_categories:
                  type: array
                  items: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                retention_policy_reference: { type: string, format: uuid }
                technical_organizational_measures:

                  minItems: 1

            CROSS_SCOPE_AUTHORITY_INVALID (a grant was presented but does not
            permit this capability here), ORGANIZATION_SCOPE_UNDETERMINED (the
            caller has no resolvable scope — fail closed) or PERMISSION_DENIED.
        "404":
          description: >-

            nothing.

          description: >-

            is missing) or PROCESSING_REGISTRY_IDENTITY_PAYLOAD_REJECTED (the
            write carried an identity attribute this service refuses to store).

                $ref: "../schemas/procedural-deadline.schema.json"
        "403":
          description: >-
            Denied with a stable reason code: CROSS_ORGANIZATION_CASE_ACCESS_DENIED
            (the write crossed an organizational boundary without authority),
            CROSS_SCOPE_AUTHORITY_INVALID (a grant was presented but does not
            permit this capability here), ORGANIZATION_SCOPE_UNDETERMINED (the

  /procedural-deadlines/{deadline_id}/transitions:
    post:
      operationId: transitionProceduralDeadline
      summary: Suspend, resume, extend, complete, escalate or expire a deadline
      description: >
        Owned by compliance-service. Maps to the six sibling commands
        suspend_deadline, resume_deadline, extend_deadline,
        complete_deadline, escalate_deadline and expire_deadline in
        epd2_compliance_service.application, which share one guard path.
        Every transition APPENDS a history entry recording due_at_before
        and due_at_after; nothing is ever overwritten, suspension
        preserves the remaining period rather than resetting the full one,
        and a deadline can never expire before its own due time. A retried
        call with the same event_id replays the recorded result instead of
        appending a second entry.
      tags: [compliance-service]

          description: The deadline being transitioned.

        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [transition, reason_code, actor_party_reference]
              properties:
                transition:
                  type: string
                  enum: [suspend, resume, extend, complete, escalate, expire]
                reason_code: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
                actor_party_reference: { type: string, format: uuid }
                additional_days:
                  type: [integer, null]
                  minimum: 1
                  description: Required for, and only used by, the extend transition.
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Deadline transitioned
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "../schemas/procedural-deadline.schema.json"
        "403":
          description: >-

            permit this capability here), ORGANIZATION_SCOPE_UNDETERMINED (the
            caller has no resolvable scope — fail closed) or PERMISSION_DENIED.
        "404":
          description: >-
            VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND. Returned identically whether the

  # =========================================================================
  # Architecture & Domain Framework 0.8.1 additions (same 0.9.0 round)
  #
  # The legal-case substrate, the official-notice trust boundary, records
  # classification and the data-protection activation gate. Three contract
  # rules are worth stating once here rather than repeating in every block:
  #
  # * Issuance, service telemetry and legal effect are THREE separate
  #   paths on purpose. `issueOfficialNotice` and `recordServiceAttempt`
  #   establish nothing; only `determineServiceEffect` can, and only it
  #   can start a deadline.
  # * A decision's effect, finality and enforceability are THREE separate
  #   paths for the same reason - a single "status" field would let a
  #   caller collapse facts the Framework requires to stay apart.
  # * Still NO delete path anywhere: not for a governed record, not for a
  #   legal case, not for a filing and not for a procedural decision. A
  #   rejected filing keeps its docket position; a closed case is reopened
  #   by a successor case, never by rewriting the closed one.
  # =========================================================================

  /legal-cases:
    post:
      operationId: openLegalCase
      summary: Open a legal case on the common legal-case substrate
      description: >
        Owned by compliance-service. Maps to
        epd2_compliance_service.application.open_legal_case. A case may only ever be opened
        inside the caller's own organization. Opening a case grants no substantive
        capability: the case cannot enter substantive_review, hearing or decided until a
        jurisdiction determination is bound to it (Framework 0.8.1 hard invariant 52), and
        this path does not accept one.
      tags: [compliance-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "../schemas/legal-case.schema.json"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Legal case opened
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "../schemas/legal-case.schema.json"
        "403":
          description: >-
            Denied with a stable reason code: CROSS_SCOPE_ACCESS_DENIED (the write crossed
            an organizational boundary without authority), CROSS_SCOPE_AUTHORITY_INVALID (a
            grant was presented but does not permit this capability here),
            ORGANIZATION_SCOPE_UNDETERMINED (the caller has no resolvable scope - fail
            closed) or PERMISSION_DENIED.
        "409":
          description: >-
            COMPLIANCE_COMMAND_CONFLICT (the same event_id was replayed with different
            content) or OPTIMISTIC_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT (the caller-supplied expected
            version no longer matches).

        corrected. A filing made by a representative is checked against the mandate's
        FILE_SUBMISSIONS authority at received_at. submitted_at and received_at are
        deliberately distinct.
      tags: [compliance-service]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "../schemas/filing.schema.json"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Filing appended to the docket
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "../schemas/filing.schema.json"
        "403":
          description: >-
            Denied with a stable reason code: CROSS_SCOPE_ACCESS_DENIED (the write crossed
            an organizational boundary without authority), CROSS_SCOPE_AUTHORITY_INVALID (a
            grant was presented but does not permit this capability here),
            ORGANIZATION_SCOPE_UNDETERMINED (the caller has no resolvable scope - fail
            closed) or PERMISSION_DENIED.
        "404":
          description: >-
            VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND. Returned identically whether the resource does not
            exist or exists in another organization and no cross-scope authority was
            presented, so a foreign id discloses nothing.
        "409":
          description: >-
            COMPLIANCE_COMMAND_CONFLICT (the same event_id was replayed with different
            content) or OPTIMISTIC_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT (the caller-supplied expected
            version no longer matches). FILING_SEQUENCE_CONFLICT, REPRESENTATION_INVALID,
            REPRESENTATION_EXPIRED, REPRESENTATION_REVOKED or PROCEDURAL_CASE_CLOSED.

===== FILE EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/contracts/reason-codes/README.md =====
# Reason Codes

`pack-02.yml` in this directory is the executable, centralized reason-code
registry required by `CLAUDE-PACK-02` section 10. It is loaded at runtime
by `epd2_core.reason_codes.ReasonCodeRegistry.load_from_yaml`.

## Contents

- All 22 canon codes from `docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md`,
  section 24 (`source: canon`), copied verbatim — their meaning is fixed
  by canon and can only change via a canon ADR and version bump.
- 16 additive codes introduced by this pack (`source: pack-02-adr-004`),
  documented and justified in
  `docs/adr/ADR-004-reason-code-registry.md` — generic validation-layer
  codes reused across services, audit-integrity codes, credential-specific
  validation failures, and `AuditEvent.reason_code` classifications for
  successfully-audited actions (canon's section-24 list is refusal-only
  and has no code that means "this succeeded").

## Rules

- No service may use a free-text string in place of a registered code
  (canon section 24). Every `reason_code`/`reason_codes` literal in
  `services/*/src` must appear in `pack-02.yml` — enforced by
  `tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`.
- New reason codes require an ADR (see ADR-004 for the precedent) and are
  additive only: no entry's `code` or `meaning` may be repurposed once
  merged.
- `introduced_in_version` is `"0.1.0"` for canon-defined codes and
  `"pack-02-0.1.0"` for pack-introduced codes.

## Status

Executable (previously documentary-only in PACK-01). Loaded and validated
by `epd2_core.reason_codes`. The PACK-02 services' `exceptions.py` /
`validation.py` modules reference these codes by string literal rather
than importing the registry at raise-time, since `epd2_core.reason_codes`
requires PyYAML, which the domain services' own `pyproject.toml` files do
not declare as a dependency (services intentionally have no direct
dependency on YAML parsing). Consistency between every literal actually
used and this registry is verified structurally by
`tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`.

# Centralized PACK-02 reason-code registry (pack section 10).
#
# This is the single source of truth for every `reason_code` string
# literal used anywhere in `services/*/src` and `packages/python/epd2-core`.
# No service may use a free-text string in place of a registered code
# (canon section 24: "reason code не заменяется свободным текстом").
#
# `source: canon` entries are copied verbatim from
# `docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md`, section 24, canon version
# 0.1.0 - their meaning must never be changed here without a canon ADR and
# version bump. `source: pack-02-adr-004` entries are additive codes
# introduced by this pack, documented and justified in
# `docs/adr/ADR-004-reason-code-registry.md`; they are backward-compatible
# additions (canon section 25's "Minor" category) and change no existing
# canon code's meaning. See ADR-004 for the full rationale, including a
# real mislabeling bug (three exceptions that reused an unrelated canon
# code for a plain lookup-miss) found and fixed while assembling this
# registry.
#
# Loaded at runtime by `epd2_core.reason_codes.ReasonCodeRegistry`.
# Validated structurally against `epd2_core.minimal_json_schema` in
# `tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py` (Task 20), which also
# scans all five services' source for `reason_code`/`reason_codes`
# literals and asserts every one is registered here.

# --- Canon section 24 codes (verbatim list, source: canon 0.1.0) ---

- code: IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED
  meaning: >-
    A downstream check (eligibility evaluation, credential issuance)
    requires a verified IdentityRecord, but the referenced identity has not
    passed verification.
  severity: error
  description: Your identity has not been verified yet, so this action cannot proceed.
  retryable: true
  owner: Identity Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_EXPIRED
  meaning: >-
    An IdentityRecord's verification has expired (naturally, or via an
    explicit revocation mapped onto this event per ADR-002) and can no
    longer be relied on by downstream contexts.
  severity: error
  description: Your identity verification has expired and needs to be renewed.
  retryable: true
  owner: Identity Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: ELIGIBILITY_NOT_MET
  meaning: >-
    An EligibilityDecision was evaluated against a rule that exists, and
    the subject's claims did not satisfy the rule's requirements.
  severity: error
  description: You do not currently meet the eligibility requirements for this action.
  retryable: false
  owner: Eligibility Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: ELIGIBILITY_PENDING
  meaning: >-
    An EligibilityDecision could not be determined automatically (required
    claims were missing or incomplete) and requires manual review.
  severity: warning
  description: Your eligibility is pending manual review.
  retryable: true
  owner: Eligibility Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED
  meaning: A ParticipationCredential was presented for validation after its expires_at.
  severity: error
  description: This credential has expired.
  retryable: false
  owner: Credential Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: CREDENTIAL_ALREADY_USED
  meaning: >-
    A single-use (or usage-limited) ParticipationCredential was presented
    again after its usage_limit was already reached.
  severity: error
  description: This credential has already been used.
  retryable: false
  owner: Credential Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: CREDENTIAL_SCOPE_MISMATCH
  meaning: >-
    A ParticipationCredential was presented for a scope_type/scope_id that
    does not match the scope it was actually issued for.
  severity: error
  description: This credential is not valid for the requested scope.
  retryable: false
  owner: Credential Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: PERMISSION_DENIED
  meaning: >-
    The requesting actor is not authorized to perform the requested
    command, in any bounded context.
  severity: error
  description: You do not have permission to perform this action.
  retryable: false
  owner: shared (all bounded contexts)
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: ROLE_CONFLICT
  meaning: An actor's assigned roles conflict in a way that forbids the requested action.
  severity: error
  description: Your current roles conflict and prevent this action.
  retryable: false
  owner: Organization Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: BALLOT_NOT_OPEN
  meaning: An action was attempted against a Ballot that is not currently open for voting.
  severity: error
  description: This ballot is not currently open.
  retryable: true
  owner: Voting Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: BALLOT_ALREADY_CLOSED
  meaning: An action was attempted against a Ballot that has already closed.
  severity: error
  description: This ballot has already closed.
  retryable: false
  owner: Voting Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: BALLOT_CONFIGURATION_LOCKED
  meaning: >-
    A change was attempted to a Ballot's configuration after it opened
    (canon INV-06 / CT-00-10 rule freeze).
  severity: error
  description: This ballot's configuration is locked and can no longer be changed.
  retryable: false
  owner: Voting Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: DUPLICATE_SUPPORT
  meaning: The same subject attempted to support the same initiative more than once.
  severity: error
  description: You have already supported this initiative.
  retryable: false
  owner: Initiative Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: DUPLICATE_VOTE
  meaning: The same subject attempted to cast a vote on the same ballot more than once.
  severity: error
  description: You have already voted on this ballot.
  retryable: false
  owner: Voting Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: DELEGATION_CYCLE
  meaning: The requested delegation would create a cycle in the delegation graph.
  severity: error
  description: This delegation would create a circular chain and cannot be created.
  retryable: false
  owner: Delegation Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: DELEGATION_EXPIRED
  meaning: A Delegation was presented or relied upon after its validity period ended.
  severity: error
  description: This delegation has expired.
  retryable: true
  owner: Delegation Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: MODERATION_POLICY_VIOLATION
  meaning: Content or an action violated a moderation policy.
  severity: error
  description: This violates the applicable moderation policy.
  retryable: false
  owner: Moderation Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: APPEAL_DEADLINE_EXPIRED
  meaning: An Appeal was submitted after its allowed deadline.
  severity: error
  description: The deadline to appeal this decision has passed.
  retryable: false
  owner: Moderation Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: EVENT_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED
  meaning: >-
    An event or credential carried a major version this reader/validator
    does not support.
  severity: error
  description: This request uses a version that is no longer supported.
  retryable: false
  owner: shared (event envelope, all bounded contexts)
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: INTEGRITY_CHECK_FAILED
  meaning: >-
    A structural or cryptographic integrity check failed (payload hash
    mismatch, signature mismatch, or equivalent).
  severity: critical
  description: An integrity check failed for this request.
  retryable: false
  owner: Audit Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: SERVICE_STATE_READ_ONLY
  meaning: The service (or a subsystem of it) is temporarily in a read-only state.
  severity: warning
  description: This service is temporarily read-only; please try again later.
  retryable: true
  owner: Governance Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

- code: EMERGENCY_FREEZE_ACTIVE
  meaning: An EmergencyAction freeze is active and forbids the requested operation (CT-00-12).
  severity: critical
  description: An emergency freeze is currently active; this action is temporarily unavailable.
  retryable: true
  owner: Governance Context
  introduced_in_version: "0.1.0"
  source: canon

# --- PACK-02 additive codes (source: pack-02-adr-004, see ADR-004) ---

- code: VALIDATION_UNKNOWN_STATUS
  meaning: >-
    A status/verification-status/decision-value string outside the
    entity's defined enum was supplied (CT-00-02).
  severity: error
  description: The status value provided is not recognized.
  retryable: false
  owner: shared (account-service, identity-service, eligibility-service, credential-service)
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: VALIDATION_FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION
  meaning: >-
    The requested status transition is not present in the entity's
    allowed-transition table (CT-00-03).
  severity: error
  description: This status change is not allowed from the entity's current status.
  retryable: false
  owner: shared (account-service, identity-service, credential-service)
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND
  meaning: >-
    No entity exists for the given identifier (a plain lookup miss),
    distinct from any business-rule refusal on a record that does exist.
    Introduced by ADR-004 to replace three exceptions that had mistakenly
    reused IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED, ELIGIBILITY_NOT_MET, and the
    non-existent CREDENTIAL_UNKNOWN_STATUS for this same lookup-miss case.
  severity: error
  description: No record was found for the given identifier.
  retryable: false
  owner: shared (identity-service, eligibility-service, credential-service)
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: AUDIT_EVENT_CONFLICT
  meaning: >-
    An audit-event append request reused an existing audit_event_id with
    different caller-controlled content (pack section 9.3, CT-00-04
    analogue for the audit log).
  severity: critical
  description: This audit event conflicts with a previously recorded event of the same ID.
  retryable: false
  owner: audit-core
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: AUDIT_CHAIN_BROKEN
  meaning: >-
    Hash-chain verification detected a mismatch between a stored event's
    recomputed hash and its recorded hash, or a broken previous_hash link
    (pack section 9.2, INV-05).
  severity: critical
  description: The audit log's integrity chain is broken.
  retryable: false
  owner: audit-core
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: CREDENTIAL_DUPLICATE_ISSUANCE_CONFLICT
  meaning: >-
    A repeated issuance request reused an existing credential_id with
    different content (CT-00-04 analogue for credential issuance).
  severity: error
  description: A credential with this identifier already exists with different content.
  retryable: false
  owner: credential-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: CREDENTIAL_REVOKED
  meaning: A ParticipationCredential was presented for validation after being revoked.
  severity: error
  description: This credential has been revoked.
  retryable: false
  owner: credential-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: CREDENTIAL_RULE_VERSION_MISMATCH
  meaning: >-
    A ParticipationCredential's rule_version does not match the
    rule_version expected by the validating caller.
  severity: error
  description: This credential was issued against a different rule version than expected.
  retryable: false
  owner: credential-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: CREDENTIAL_DIGEST_MISMATCH
  meaning: >-
    A ParticipationCredential's eligibility_snapshot_digest does not match
    the digest expected by the validating caller.
  severity: error
  description: This credential's eligibility snapshot digest does not match.
  retryable: false
  owner: credential-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING
  meaning: >-
    A ParticipationCredential is missing a field required for validation
    (e.g. an empty eligibility_snapshot_digest).
  severity: error
  description: This credential is missing a field required for validation.
  retryable: false
  owner: credential-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: ELIGIBILITY_RULE_VERSION_FROZEN
  meaning: >-
    A caller attempted to re-submit an existing
    (eligibility_rule_id, rule_version) pair with different content
    (canon section 9.1 rule-freeze requirement).
  severity: error
  description: This rule version is frozen and cannot be changed.
  retryable: false
  owner: eligibility-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: CREDENTIAL_ISSUED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for a successfully issued
    ParticipationCredential (INV-04 audit trail; no refusal occurred).
  severity: info
  description: A participation credential was issued.
  retryable: false
  owner: credential-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: IDENTITY_VERIFIED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for a successful identity
    verification (INV-04 audit trail; no refusal occurred).
  severity: info
  description: An identity was successfully verified.
  retryable: false
  owner: identity-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_STARTED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for the creation of a new
    IdentityRecord in pending status (INV-04 audit trail; no refusal
    occurred).
  severity: info
  description: An identity verification process was started.
  retryable: false
  owner: identity-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_REVOKED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for an explicit administrative
    revocation of a verified IdentityRecord, distinct from a
    system-detected natural expiry. Both map to the same canonical
    `identity.verification_expired` event per ADR-002 (canon defines no
    separate revocation event), but the audit trail's reason_code
    preserves the distinction the event name cannot.
  severity: warning
  description: An identity verification was explicitly revoked.
  retryable: true
  owner: identity-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: IDENTITY_DUPLICATE_SUSPECTED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for an IdentityRecord
    transitioning to duplicate_suspected (a possible duplicate identity
    was detected during verification).
  severity: warning
  description: A possible duplicate identity was detected.
  retryable: true
  owner: identity-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: IDENTITY_MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for an IdentityRecord
    transitioning to manual_review_required.
  severity: warning
  description: This identity verification requires manual review.
  retryable: true
  owner: identity-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: ELIGIBILITY_MET
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for an eligibility decision that
    resulted in ELIGIBLE (INV-04 audit trail; no refusal occurred).
  severity: info
  description: An eligibility decision resulted in a positive determination.
  retryable: false
  owner: eligibility-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: ELIGIBILITY_SNAPSHOT_CREATED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for the creation of an
    EligibilitySnapshot (INV-04 audit trail; no refusal occurred).
  severity: info
  description: An eligibility snapshot was created.
  retryable: false
  owner: eligibility-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: ACCOUNT_CREATED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for the creation of a new
    Account (INV-04 audit trail; no refusal occurred).
  severity: info
  description: An account was created.
  retryable: false
  owner: account-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004

- code: ACCOUNT_STATUS_CHANGED
  meaning: >-
    AuditEvent.reason_code classification for an Account status transition
    that reaches a canonical event (INV-04 audit trail; no refusal
    occurred). The specific transition is carried by AuditEvent.event_type;
    this code intentionally covers every transition rather than one code
    per transition.
  severity: info
  description: An account's status was changed.
  retryable: false
  owner: account-service
  introduced_in_version: "pack-02-0.1.0"
  source: pack-02-adr-004


===== FILE EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/contracts/reason-codes/pack-03.yml =====
# Centralized PACK-03 reason-code registry (ADR-006).
#
# This is the single source of truth for every `reason_code` string
# literal used anywhere in the six PACK-03 services'
# (initiative-service, deliberation-service, moderation-service,
# voting-service, tally-service, delegation-service) `src/`. No PACK-03
# service may use a free-text string in place of a registered code
# (canon section 24: "reason code \u043d\u0435 \u0437\u0430\u043c\u0435\u043d\u044f\u0435\u0442\u0441\u044f \u0441\u0432\u043e\u0431\u043e\u0434\u043d\u044b\u043c \u0442\u0435\u043a\u0441\u0442\u043e\u043c").
#
# This is a SEPARATE registry file from contracts/reason-codes/pack-02.yml
# (ADR-006, Option B - see docs/adr/ADR-006-pack-03-reason-code-additions.md):
# PACK-02's five services and PACK-03's six services each have their own
# reason-code registry; codes that both need (e.g. PERMISSION_DENIED,
# VALIDATION_UNKNOWN_STATUS) are independently redeclared here rather than
# imported from pack-02.yml, so each pack's registry remains a complete,
# standalone source of truth for its own services.
#
# `source: canon` entries are the nine PACK-03-relevant canon section-24
# codes plus five reused shared/generic canon codes, all copied verbatim
# from docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md section 24, canon
# version 0.2.0 - their meaning must never be changed here without a canon
# ADR and version bump. `source: pack-03-adr-006` entries are additive
# codes introduced by this pack, documented and justified in
# docs/adr/ADR-006-pack-03-reason-code-additions.md; they are
# backward-compatible additions (canon section 25's "Minor" category) and
# change no existing canon code's meaning.
#
# Loaded at runtime by `epd2_core.reason_codes.ReasonCodeRegistry`.
# Validated structurally and scanned for every `reason_code` literal used
# in the six PACK-03 services by `tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`.

===== FILE EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/contracts/reason-codes/pack-04.yml =====
# Centralized PACK-04 reason-code registry (ADR-014).
#
# This is the single source of truth for every `reason_code` string
# literal used in the one PACK-04 service's (transparency-service) `src/`.
# No PACK-04 service may use a free-text string in place of a registered
# code (canon section 24: "reason code не заменяется свободным текстом").
#
# This is a SEPARATE registry file from contracts/reason-codes/pack-02.yml
# and contracts/reason-codes/pack-03.yml (ADR-006, Option B precedent,
# extended by ADR-014): each pack's services have their own reason-code
# registry; codes that multiple packs need (e.g. PERMISSION_DENIED,
# VALIDATION_UNKNOWN_STATUS) are independently redeclared here rather than
# imported from an earlier pack's file, so each pack's registry remains a
# complete, standalone source of truth for its own services.
#
# `source: canon` entries are the shared/generic canon section-24 codes
# this pack reuses verbatim, copied from
# docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, canon version 0.3.0 - their
# meaning must never be changed here without a canon ADR and version bump.
# `source: pack-04-adr-014` entries are the six additive codes ADR-014
# introduces, documented and justified in
# docs/adr/ADR-014-pack-04-reason-code-additions.md; they are
# backward-compatible additions (canon section 25's "Minor" category) and
# change no existing canon code's meaning. `source: pack-04-service` entries
# are this service's own additive duplicate-conflict and audit-success
# classification codes (the same additive pattern ADR-006 already
# established for PACK-03's own services), not named by ADR-014 itself but
# following its precedent.
#
# Loaded at runtime by `epd2_core.reason_codes.ReasonCodeRegistry`.
# Validated structurally and scanned for every `reason_code` literal used
# in transparency-service by `tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`.

- code: VALIDATION_UNKNOWN_STATUS
  meaning: An entity's status (or an equivalent closed-value field) does not match any known enum value.
  severity: error
  description: This value is not a recognized status.
  retryable: false
  owner: Transparency Context (transparency-service)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon
- code: VALIDATION_FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION

  severity: error
  description: This status change is not allowed.
  retryable: false
  owner: Transparency Context (transparency-service)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon
- code: VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND

  severity: error
  description: No record was found for the given identifier.
  retryable: false
  owner: Transparency Context (transparency-service)
  introduced_in_version: 0.1.0
  source: canon

- code: LOBBY_LOG_ENTRY_INCOMPLETE

===== FILE EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/contracts/reason-codes/pack-05.yml =====
# Centralized PACK-05 reason-code registry (ADR-019).
#
# This is the single source of truth for every `reason_code` string
# literal used in the one PACK-05 service's (governance-service) `src/`.
# No PACK-05 service may use a free-text string in place of a registered
# code (canon section 24: "reason code не заменяется свободным текстом").
#
# This is a SEPARATE registry file from contracts/reason-codes/pack-02.yml,
# contracts/reason-codes/pack-03.yml, and contracts/reason-codes/pack-04.yml
# (ADR-006 Option B precedent, extended by ADR-014 and now ADR-019, Option
# A): each pack's services have their own reason-code registry; codes that
# multiple packs need (e.g. PERMISSION_DENIED, VALIDATION_UNKNOWN_STATUS)
# are independently redeclared here rather than imported from an earlier
# pack's file, so each pack's registry remains a complete, standalone
# source of truth for its own services.
#
# `BALLOT_INVALIDATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED` is independently redeclared here
# AND in contracts/reason-codes/pack-03.yml, following the same
# already-established "reused generic code" pattern: the reason_code
# literal is used by both governance-service's own documentation-copy
# exception class and voting-service's real `invalidate_ballot` guard
# (ADR-017 Option B), so `test_reason_codes_registry.py`'s per-pack scan
# requires it registered in both packs' own registries.
#
# `source: canon` entries are the shared/generic canon section-24 codes
# this pack reuses verbatim, copied from
# docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, canon version 0.4.0 - their
# meaning must never be changed here without a canon ADR and version bump.
# `source: pack-05-spec` entries are the nine codes
# `docs/handover/PACK-05-SPEC.md` section 7 originally proposed, carried
# forward unchanged by ADR-019. `source: pack-05-adr-019` entries are the
# four additive codes ADR-019 introduced per the owner's explicit
# instruction (backward-compatible additions, canon section 25's "Minor"
# category, changing no existing canon code's meaning). `source:
# pack-05-service` entries are this service's own additive
# duplicate-conflict and audit-success classification codes, not named by
# ADR-019 itself but following the same additive pattern ADR-006/ADR-014
# already established for PACK-03's and PACK-04's own services.
#
# Loaded at runtime by `epd2_core.reason_codes.ReasonCodeRegistry`.
# Validated structurally and scanned for every `reason_code` literal used
# in governance-service by `tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`.

# through pack-05.yml (ADR-006 Option B precedent, extended by ADR-014,

# PERMISSION_DENIED, VALIDATION_UNKNOWN_STATUS) are independently

# this pack reuses verbatim. `source: pack-06-spec` entries are the

# AI_REVIEWER_ROLE_INVALID and AI_REVIEWER_SCOPE_MISMATCH are the only
# codes ai-processing-service itself ever *raises* upon receiving
# authorized: false from governance-service's verify_role_assignment_for_
# action read - this pack never raises governance-service's own pack-05
# codes. review_ai_output does, however, read (never raise)

===== FILE EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/contracts/reason-codes/pack-07.yml =====
# Centralized PACK-07 reason-code registry (canon-0.6.0's own 19d.15 list,
# ADR-026 through ADR-031).
#
# This is the single source of truth for every `reason_code` string
# literal introduced by the PACK-07 implementation round: the NEW codes
# `eligibility-service`/`identity-service` (both pre-existing PACK-02
# services, extended in place rather than replaced) gained, plus every
# code `membership-service` (PACK-07's one wholly new service) uses.
# No PACK-07 code path may use a free-text string in place of a
# registered code (canon section 24).
#
# This is a SEPARATE registry file from contracts/reason-codes/pack-02.yml
# through pack-06.yml (ADR-006 Option B precedent, extended by ADR-014,
# ADR-019, ADR-024, and now this implementation round): codes that
# multiple packs need (e.g. PERMISSION_DENIED, VALIDATION_UNKNOWN_STATUS,
# IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED) are independently redeclared here rather than
# imported from an earlier pack's file, so this file remains a complete,
# standalone source of truth for membership-service's own scan
# (`tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`'s `PACK07_SERVICE_DIRS`).
#
# `eligibility-service` and `identity-service` are the one exception to
# "each pack owns a disjoint set of services": both are PACK-02 services
# that also gained PACK-07 additive functions in this implementation
# round. Their own source is checked against the UNION of this file and
# pack-02.yml (never this file alone) - see
# `test_reason_codes_registry.py`'s `PACK07_SHARED_WITH_PACK02_SERVICE_DIRS`
# and its `_EXTRA_REGISTRIES_FOR_LITERAL_CHECK` mapping.
#
# `source: canon-19d15` entries are canon 19d.15's own explicitly-approved
# reason-code list (task 15 of the PACK-07 implementation scope), copied
# verbatim. `source: pack-07-service` entries are additive codes this
# implementation round introduced for its own audit/event bookkeeping
# (activation confirmations, submission/decision markers), following the
# same additive pattern ADR-004/ADR-014/ADR-019/ADR-024 already
# established. `source: pack-02-reused` entries are generic, pre-existing
# PACK-02 codes reused verbatim by membership-service (and, in
# eligibility-service's/identity-service's own case, already covered by
# pack-02.yml directly - duplicated here only so this file stays a
# complete, standalone reference for membership-service's own scan).
#
# Loaded at runtime by `epd2_core.reason_codes.ReasonCodeRegistry`.
