# Centralized PACK-08 reason-code registry (canon-0.7.0 section 19e /
# section 24's own 10-code list, ADR-032 through ADR-037).
#
# This is the single source of truth for every `reason_code` string
# literal introduced by the PACK-08 implementation round: the 10 codes
# canon section 24 itself names for the Organization & Regional Scope
# domain, plus the narrowly-necessary additive codes
# `organization-service` (PACK-08's one wholly new service) uses for its
# own audit/event bookkeeping (creation/activation/status-change
# confirmations, relation/authority lifecycle markers), following the
# same additive pattern ADR-004/ADR-014/ADR-019/ADR-024/pack-07's own
# registry already established. No PACK-08 code path may use a free-text
# string in place of a registered code (canon section 24).
#
# This is a SEPARATE registry file from contracts/reason-codes/pack-02.yml
# through pack-07.yml (ADR-006 Option B precedent): codes that multiple
# packs need (e.g. PERMISSION_DENIED, VALIDATION_UNKNOWN_STATUS,
# VALIDATION_FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION, VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND) are
# independently redeclared here rather than imported from an earlier
# pack's file, so this file remains a complete, standalone source of
# truth for organization-service's own scan
# (`tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`'s `PACK08_SERVICE_DIRS`).
# `organization-service` is a single, wholly new service (no existing
# PACK-02-through-PACK-07 service is extended in place this round), so
# unlike PACK-07's file there is no "shared with an earlier pack's
# service directory" union needed for the literal-usage check.
#
# `source: canon-24` entries are canon section 24's own explicitly-named
# 10-code list for the Organization & Regional Scope domain (task item 18
# of the PACK-08 implementation scope), copied verbatim. `source:
# pack-08-service` entries are additive codes this implementation round
# introduced for its own audit/event bookkeeping (organization lifecycle
# confirmations, relation/authority lifecycle markers, dual-control/
# temporary-supervision guards), following the same additive pattern
# established by every earlier pack's registry. `source: pack-02-reused`
# entries are generic, pre-existing PACK-02 codes reused verbatim by
# organization-service (already registered in pack-02.yml; independently
# redeclared here so this file stays a complete, standalone reference for
# organization-service's own scan).
#
# Loaded at runtime by `epd2_core.reason_codes.ReasonCodeRegistry`.

# --- Canon section 24's ten Organization & Regional Scope codes ----------

- code: ORGANIZATION_NOT_ACTIVE
  meaning: >-
    The referenced Organization is not currently in an active status
    (canon 8.1) - a draft, restricted, or archived organization cannot
    issue new organizational authority or otherwise act as an active
    party to the requested operation.
  severity: error
  description: This organization is not currently active.
  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

- code: ORGANIZATION_SCOPE_MISMATCH
  meaning: >-
    The supplied OrganizationalScope does not match the scope actually
    required for the requested operation (scope_type and/or
    scope_reference differ).
  severity: error
  description: The organizational scope provided does not match what is required for this action.
  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

- code: CROSS_SCOPE_ACCESS_DENIED
  meaning: >-
    A regional-scope-authorization check (canon 19e.12) evaluated all six
    access modes (exact/ancestor/descendant/delegated-cross-scope/
    temporary-supervision/institutional-oversight-without-data-access)
    and found no grant covering the requested (actor_scope, target_scope,
    action_code) triple - the engine's default is deny.
  severity: error
  description: You are not authorized to access this organizational scope.
  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

- code: AUTHORITY_ASSIGNMENT_INVALID
  meaning: >-
    An OrganizationalAuthority assignment failed validation - e.g. the
    appointing organization is not active, the assignment's effective
    window is invalid, or a required policy_version/decision_reference is
    missing.
  severity: error
  description: This authority assignment is not valid.
  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

- code: AUTHORITY_ROLE_INCOMPATIBLE
  meaning: >-
    The candidate role_code conflicts with an existing active role_code
    already held by the same assigned_subject_reference in the same
    OrganizationalScope, per the role incompatibility baseline (canon
    19e.16, PAIRWISE_INCOMPATIBLE_ROLES).
  severity: error
  description: This role cannot be combined with a role you already hold in this scope.
  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

- code: AUTHORITY_SCOPE_INVALID
  meaning: >-
    An OrganizationalAuthority's own OrganizationalScope value fails
    validation (e.g. empty scope_reference/owning_domain, or a scope
    shape inconsistent with the authority's role_code).
  severity: error
  description: The scope specified for this authority is not valid.
  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

- code: SUCCESSOR_TRANSFER_REQUIRES_DECISION
  meaning: >-
    Canon 19e.10's hard invariant: a merge/split/successor relation alone
    never automatically transfers role, authority, access, or entitlement
    - any such transfer requires its own, explicit, distinct governed
    decision reference, separate from the reorganization's own decision.
  severity: error
  description: Transferring authority as part of a reorganization requires its own separate governed decision.
  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

- code: ORGANIZATIONAL_RELATION_OVERLAP
  meaning: >-
    A new hierarchy-category relation's [valid_from, valid_until) window
    overlaps an existing active relation asserting a different parent for
    the same child (or a second concurrent child for the same
    parent-shaped role), and no OrganizationalHierarchyOverlapPolicy
    explicitly permits the overlap.
  severity: error
  description: This organizational relationship overlaps with an existing one that is not permitted to coexist.
  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

- code: ORGANIZATIONAL_CYCLE_FORBIDDEN
  meaning: >-
    Adding the candidate relation would create a cycle in a
    hierarchy-category relation type (parent_of/subordinate_to, cycles
    forbidden without exception - canon 19e.7) or in
    temporary_supervision_by (canon 19e.7's own no-cycle rule for that
    cooperation-category type).
  severity: error
  description: This organizational relationship would create a forbidden cycle.
  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

- code: HISTORICAL_SCOPE_NOT_EFFECTIVE
  meaning: >-
    A historical or future-dated query's evaluation time does not fall
    within the referenced record's [valid_from, valid_until) effective
    window.
  severity: error
  description: This organizational record was not effective at the requested time.
  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.8.0
  source: canon-24

===== FILE EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/contracts/reason-codes/pack-09.yml =====
# Centralized PACK-09 reason-code registry (Compliance, Records
# Governance & Legal Workflows; ADR-038 through ADR-042).
#
# This is the single source of truth for every `reason_code` string
# literal introduced by the PACK-09 implementation round: the codes
# `compliance-service` raises for records governance, Legal Hold,
# controlled disposal, the Data Catalog & Processing Registry, governed
# procedural cases, deadlines, data-subject/legal requests and party
# arbitration - plus the additive codes it uses for its own audit
# bookkeeping, following the same pattern ADR-004/ADR-014/ADR-019/
# ADR-024 and PACK-07's and PACK-08's own registries already established.
# No PACK-09 code path may use a free-text string in place of a
# registered code (canon section 24; PACK-09 required invariant 14,
# "reason-coded denial").
#
# This is a SEPARATE registry file from contracts/reason-codes/pack-02.yml
# through pack-08.yml (ADR-006 Option B precedent): codes multiple packs
# need (PERMISSION_DENIED, VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND) are independently
# redeclared here rather than imported from an earlier pack's file, so
# this file stays a complete, standalone source of truth for
# `compliance-service`'s own scan
# (`tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`'s PACK09_SERVICE_DIRS).
# `compliance-service` is a single, wholly new service - no existing
# PACK-02-through-PACK-08 service is extended in place this round - so
# unlike PACK-07's file there is no "shared with an earlier pack's service
# directory" union needed for the literal-usage check.
#
# `source: pack-09-service` entries are the codes this round introduced.
# `source: pack-02-reused` entries are generic, pre-existing PACK-02 codes
# reused verbatim by compliance-service (already registered in
# pack-02.yml; independently redeclared here so this file stays complete).
#
# Every entry carries the seven fields
# `epd2_core.reason_codes.ReasonCodeRegistry.load_from_yaml` requires
# (code, meaning, severity, description, retryable, owner,
# introduced_in_version); a missing field makes the whole registry fail to
# load, which is why the pre-review draft of this file - which omitted
# `description` and `retryable` - could not be loaded at all.

# --- Records governance, retention and controlled destruction (ADR-039)

- code: RETENTION_DISPOSITION_NOT_DUE
  meaning: >-
    The calculated retention due time has not been reached for this
    governed record, so no disposition may be authorized or executed.
  severity: error
  description: This record's retention period has not expired yet.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: RETENTION_START_UNDETERMINED
  meaning: >-
    No retention start event has been recorded for this record, so its
    due time cannot be calculated. The operation fails closed rather
    than treating "no start" as "started at creation" (required
    invariant 15).
  severity: error
  description: Retention has not been started for this record.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: RETENTION_POLICY_VERSION_CONFLICT
  meaning: >-
    A retention policy id/version pair is already registered with
    different content, or a supersession skipped the required version
    increment. Policy versions are append-only and are never rewritten
    in place.
  severity: error
  description: This retention policy version already exists with different content.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: RETENTION_POLICY_REBIND_REQUIRES_REEVALUATION
  meaning: >-
    A governed record's effective retention policy version changed and
    disposal eligibility has not been re-evaluated and re-authorized
    under the new version. Rewriting a retention schedule never, by
    itself, authorizes destruction of already-governed records (required
    invariant 5).
  severity: error
  description: Re-evaluate and re-authorize disposal under the new policy version.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: DESTRUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED
  meaning: >-
    Execution of a disposal or destruction was requested without a
    valid, matching DestructionAuthorization. Governed records are never
    removed by an ordinary delete; a separate, explicit authorization
    step is mandatory (required invariant 4).
  severity: error
  description: This destruction has not been authorized.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: DESTRUCTION_AUTHORIZATION_STALE
  meaning: >-
    The supplied DestructionAuthorization was issued against a different
    retention policy version or a different record version than the
    record now carries, so it no longer applies.
  severity: error
  description: This destruction authorization is no longer current.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: DESTRUCTION_ALREADY_EXECUTED
  meaning: >-
    Destruction evidence already exists for this record and a second,
    different execution was attempted. An identical replay is idempotent
    and never produces this code.
  severity: error
  description: This record has already been destroyed with different evidence.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: GOVERNED_RECORD_DELETION_FORBIDDEN
  meaning: >-
    A caller attempted to remove a governed record through an ordinary
    delete path instead of the controlled disposal workflow (required
    invariant 4).
  severity: error
  description: Governed records cannot be deleted directly.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

# --- Organizational scope isolation and fail-closed guards -------------

- code: CROSS_SCOPE_ACCESS_DENIED
  meaning: >-
    A write crossed its target's owning organizational scope without a
    valid, explicitly-presented cross-scope authority grant. There is no
    hierarchy-derived inheritance: a parent organization holds nothing
    over a child's records automatically (required invariant 2).
  severity: error
  description: This operation crosses an organizational boundary without authority.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: ORGANIZATION_SCOPE_UNDETERMINED
  meaning: >-

    or an entity was submitted without one. The operation is refused
    rather than defaulted to any organization (required invariant 15).
  severity: error
  description: The organizational scope of this request could not be determined.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: CROSS_SCOPE_AUTHORITY_INVALID

- code: COMPLIANCE_COMMAND_CONFLICT

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Architecture & Domain Framework 0.8.1 additions (same 0.9.0 round).
#
# The refusal codes below make the Framework's own hard invariants
# answerable at runtime: each one names a specific structural refusal
# rather than a generic validation failure, so a denial can be audited,
# reported to a party, and distinguished from every neighbouring denial.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

- code: JURISDICTION_MISSING
  meaning: >-
    A case was asked to enter a substantive status - substantive
    review, hearing or decided - while no jurisdiction determination is
    bound to it. Framework hard invariant 52: no consequential outcome
    without a competent authority. Refused rather than defaulted.
  severity: error
  description: This case has no confirmed jurisdiction.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: JURISDICTION_NOT_COMPETENT
  meaning: >-
    The bound jurisdiction determination exists but does not permit a
    substantive decision at this instant: it is challenged, declined,
    transferred, or outside its own validity window. A contested
    competence does not keep producing binding outcomes while the
    challenge is pending.
  severity: error
  description: The determined authority is not competent to decide this matter now.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: JURISDICTION_TRANSFER_REQUIRED
  meaning: >-
    A transfer was attempted without a successor determination that
    names the determination it supersedes. Competence is never left
    dangling: the outgoing determination must point at a specific
    successor.
  severity: error
  description: A jurisdiction transfer requires a successor determination.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: JURISDICTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH
  meaning: >-
    A jurisdiction determination was submitted for a different case, a
    different organization or a different case kind than the case it
    was to be bound to. Scope is compared, never coerced.
  severity: error
  description: The jurisdiction determination does not match this case.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: REPRESENTATION_INVALID
  meaning: >-
    A representative acted without a mandate linking them to the
    represented party on this case, or the mandate does not grant the
    specific authority the act requires. Framework hard invariant 15: a
    role name is not proof of authority.
  severity: error
  description: No valid representation mandate covers this act.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: REPRESENTATION_EXPIRED
  meaning: >-
    The mandate exists but the act falls outside its validity window.
    Acts inside the window stay valid; only this act is refused.
  severity: error
  description: The representation mandate was not in force at that time.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: REPRESENTATION_REVOKED
  meaning: >-
    The mandate was revoked before the act. Revocation is
    forward-looking: filings already accepted under the mandate remain
    valid and are not rewritten.
  severity: error
  description: The representation mandate has been revoked.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: FILING_INADMISSIBLE
  meaning: >-
    A filing was refused at intake. It stays on the docket at its
    original sequence in rejected state with this code; it is never
    removed, because 'this was filed and refused' is itself part of the
    record.
  severity: error
  description: This filing is not admissible.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: FILING_SEQUENCE_CONFLICT
  meaning: >-
    A filing claimed a docket position that is not the next one, tried
    to supersede itself, or tried to be superseded by a filing at an
    earlier position. The docket is append-only and strictly ordered; a
    conflicting sequence is refused rather than silently corrected.
  severity: error
  description: The docket position for this filing is not available.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: HEARING_TRANSITION_INVALID
  meaning: >-
    A hearing transition was requested that its current status does not
    permit - for example completing a cancelled hearing. Hearing status
    is derived from an append-only history, so an invalid transition
    cannot be written and then re-derived away.
  severity: error
  description: This hearing cannot make that transition.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: INTERIM_MEASURE_AUTHORITY_DENIED
  meaning: >-
    A granted interim measure was constructed without a human deciding
    authority, without an end or review date, or without a reasons
    reference. Framework hard invariant 69: AI decides no consequential
    legal outcomes; an indefinite unreasoned measure is not
    expressible.
  severity: error
  description: This interim measure cannot be granted as specified.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: DECISION_NOT_EFFECTIVE
  meaning: >-
    An operation required the decision to be in legal effect and it is
    not - it has not commenced, or its effect is suspended. Effect,
    finality and enforceability are three separate facts and none is
    derived from another.
  severity: error
  description: This decision is not in effect.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: DECISION_NOT_FINAL
  meaning: >-
    An operation required the decision to be final - the remedy window
    closed or exhausted - and it is not. Finality is not implied by
    effect and is not implied by enforceability.
  severity: error
  description: This decision is not final.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: DECISION_NOT_ENFORCEABLE
  meaning: >-
    Enforceability was requested while the decision is not in effect,
    or was requested twice. A final decision whose effect is suspended
    is not enforceable, and that combination is inexpressible rather
    than merely discouraged.
  severity: error
  description: This decision is not enforceable.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: REMEDY_UNAVAILABLE
  meaning: >-
    A remedy was exercised outside its availability window - before it
    opened or after it expired. Framework hard invariant 52 requires a
    remedy route to exist; it does not make that route permanently
    open.
  severity: error
  description: This remedy is not available now.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: DUE_PROCESS_PREREQUISITE_MISSING
  meaning: >-
    A consequential decision was attempted with at least one of the six
    named prerequisites absent: jurisdiction, legally effective notice,
    an opportunity to respond, a human deciding actor, reasons, or an
    available remedy. Framework hard invariant 52 in executable form;
    the missing prerequisite is named in the message.
  severity: error
  description: A prerequisite for this decision is missing.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: RECUSAL_REQUIRED
  meaning: >-
    A conflict assessment concluded that the actor must not exercise
    decision capability on this matter, and no replacement has been
    assigned. The case cannot proceed through this actor.
  severity: error
  description: A recusal is required before this can proceed.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: RECUSED_ACTOR_DENIED
  meaning: >-
    The acting party is recused from this case with effect at or before
    this act. Framework hard invariant 53: recusal blocks capability
    without erasing history - the actor's earlier acts stay on the
    record and are not invalidated.
  severity: error
  description: This actor is recused from this matter.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: NOTICE_METHOD_INVALID
  meaning: >-
    A service attempt used a method the notice does not authorize.
    Refused at recording time rather than at determination time, so an
    unauthorized channel never accumulates as evidence that later
    resembles proof of service. Framework hard invariant 40.
  severity: error
  description: That service method is not authorized for this notice.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: SERVICE_NOT_PROVEN
  meaning: >-
    No reconciled attempt supports the deemed-service rule invoked, or
    there were no attempts at all. This is the code that makes
    'delivered' provider telemetry insufficient on its own: issuing a
    notice is not serving it, and unreconciled telemetry is not proof.
    Framework hard invariants 39 and 57.
  severity: error
  description: Service of this notice is not proven.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: NOTICE_EFFECT_UNDETERMINED
  meaning: >-
    Legal effect could not be established or refused on the evidence
    available - every attempt's telemetry is unknown. Fail-closed: an
    undetermined effect starts no deadline. Framework hard invariant
    39.
  severity: error
  description: The legal effect of this notice is undetermined.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: NOTICE_EFFECT_ALREADY_ESTABLISHED
  meaning: >-
    A second effect determination was attempted for a notice that
    already has one establishing legal effect. Legal effect is created
    exactly once; an identical replay is handled idempotently above
    this check and never reaches it. Framework hard invariant 59.
  severity: error
  description: The legal effect of this notice is already established.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: DUPLICATE_LEGAL_EFFECT_PREVENTED
  meaning: >-
    A retry or replay tried to start a second deadline from a notice
    effect that has already triggered one. Framework hard invariant 59:
    retry and replay do not repeat a consequential legal effect.
  severity: error
  description: That legal effect has already been applied.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: DEADLINE_TRIGGER_INVALID
  meaning: >-
    A deadline was asked to start from a source that is not a governed
    trigger - delivery telemetry or read telemetry - or from a notice
    effect that establishes no legal effect. Those telemetry sources
    exist in the enum by name precisely so this refusal is explicit
    rather than an omission. Framework hard invariant 39.
  severity: error
  description: That trigger cannot start a procedural deadline.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: DPIA_REQUIRED
  meaning: >-
    A processing activity in a risk class that requires a data
    protection impact assessment has none, or no requirement
    determination has ever been recorded for it. Absence of the
    determination is itself blocking: 'nobody asked' and 'we asked and
    the answer was no' are different states.
  severity: error
  description: A data protection impact assessment is required first.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: DPIA_NOT_APPROVED
  meaning: >-
    The assessment exists but is not in an activating state at this
    instant - it is in draft, under review, rejected, expired, or past
    its own validity date. An approved assessment past validity
    activates nothing.
  severity: error
  description: The data protection impact assessment is not approved.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: PROCESSING_ACTIVATION_BLOCKED
  meaning: >-
    Activation of a processing activity was refused by the governance

  severity: error
  description: This processing activity cannot be activated.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0
  source: pack-09-service

- code: DPO_INDEPENDENCE_REQUIRED
  meaning: >-
    The assessment's reviewer is the controller or the process owner.

  severity: error
  description: The reviewer must be independent of the controller and process owner.
  retryable: false
  owner: compliance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.9.0

- code: LEGAL_HOLD_PROPAGATION_UNRESOLVED
  meaning: >-
    At least one known derivative of a hold - a replica, index, export

  severity: error
  description: Legal hold propagation is not resolved.

===== FILE EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/contracts/reason-codes/pack-10.yml =====
# Centralized PACK-10 reason-code registry (Party Finance, Accounting &
# Rechenschaftsbericht; canon 0.8.0 section 19f, ADR-048 through ADR-054).
#
# This is the single source of truth for every `reason_code` string
# literal introduced or used by the PACK-10 implementation round: the
# codes `finance-service` raises for the authoritative accounting
# register, accounting periods, contributions, sponsorship and external
# financial benefit, expenses and payments, assets and obligations, the
# reporting perimeter and snapshot, the twelve-state
# `Rechenschaftsbericht` lifecycle, the independent finance audit, the
# purpose-scoped party reference and public disclosure control - plus the
# additive codes it uses for its own audit bookkeeping, following the same
# pattern ADR-004/ADR-014/ADR-019/ADR-024 and PACK-07's, PACK-08's and
# PACK-09's own registries already established. No PACK-10 code path may
# use a free-text string in place of a registered code (canon section 24;
# `ФИН-40`, "reason-coded refusal").
#
# This is a SEPARATE registry file from contracts/reason-codes/pack-02.yml
# through pack-09.yml (ADR-006 Option B precedent): codes several packs
# need (PERMISSION_DENIED, VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND) are independently
# redeclared here rather than imported from an earlier pack's file, so
# this file stays a complete, standalone source of truth for
# `finance-service`'s own scan
# (`tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`'s PACK10_SERVICE_DIRS).
# `finance-service` is a single, wholly new service - no existing
# PACK-02-through-PACK-09 service is extended in place this round - so,
# like PACK-08's and PACK-09's files and unlike PACK-07's, there is no
# "shared with an earlier pack's service directory" union needed for the
# literal-usage check.
#
# `source: canon-0.8.0` entries are the forty-five FINANCE_* codes canon
# section 24 introduced with the 0.8.0 amendment. Their meaning is fixed
# by canon and can only change through a canon ADR and a canon version
# bump; this file restates them, it does not define them.
#
# `source: pack-10-service` entries are the nineteen additive codes this
# implementation round introduced. Four are refusals canon section 24 has
# no code for, and each says in its own `meaning` why the nearest canon
# code would have been wrong. Fifteen are `AuditEvent.reason_code`
# classifications for successfully-audited acts - canon's section-24 list
# is refusal-only and contains no code that means "this succeeded", which
# is the same gap ADR-004 recorded for PACK-02.
#
# `source: pack-0X-reused` entries are pre-existing generic codes reused
# verbatim (already registered in that pack's own file; independently
# redeclared here so this file stays complete). PACK-10 deliberately
# reuses rather than shadowing: retention and legal hold remain PACK-09's
# domain, organizational scope and authority remain PACK-08's, and a
# FINANCE_-prefixed duplicate of either would create two codes for one
# fact. Conversely, four existing code families that *look* applicable are
# NOT reused - pack-03's CONTRIBUTION_* (a deliberation utterance),
# pack-04's LEDGER_ENTRY_* (a public transparency ledger entry), pack-02's
# ACCOUNT_* (a platform user account) and pack-02/04's AUDIT_* (audit-log
# integrity) - because each names a different entity in a different
# context; see docs/packs/PACK-10-SPECIFICATION.md section 15.3.
#
# Every entry carries the seven fields
# `epd2_core.reason_codes.ReasonCodeRegistry.load_from_yaml` requires
# (code, meaning, severity, description, retryable, owner,
# introduced_in_version); a missing field makes the whole registry fail to
# load.

# --- Canon 0.8.0 section 24 finance codes (forty-five) ---------------

- code: FINANCE_AUTHORITY_MISSING
  meaning: >-
    No active, scope-matching finance authority exists for this action.
    A role name is never itself proof of a financial authority: it
    resolves to an effective, scope-matching OrganizationalAuthority or
    RoleAssignment record, or the action is refused.
  severity: error
  description: No finance authority for this action in this scope.
  retryable: false
  owner: finance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.10.0
  source: canon-0.8.0

- code: FINANCE_AUDITOR_INDEPENDENCE_VIOLATION
  meaning: >-
    The candidate finance auditor fails the independence check for this
    scope and period. Independence is mandatory and is re-verified at
    the moment of the act, never assumed from a prior grant.
  severity: error
  description: The auditor is not independent of what is being audited.
  retryable: false
  owner: finance-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.10.0
  source: canon-0.8.0

- code: FINANCE_ACCOUNTING_PERIOD_CLOSED
  meaning: >-

  owner: finance-service

===== FILE EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/contracts/reason-codes/pack-11.yml =====
# Centralized PACK-11 reason-code registry (Governed Documents &
# Evidence; FIR-ROADMAP-001, FIR-INV-010; ADR-055 through ADR-060).
#
# This is the single source of truth for every `reason_code` string
# literal introduced or used by the PACK-11 implementation round: the
# codes `document-service` raises for the document register, immutable
# hash-linked versions, document content, controlled review and approval,
# the publication lifecycle, correction, supersession and revocation, the
# governed signature and admissibility determinations, evidence with
# provenance and chain of custody, sealed evidence bundles, and the
# retention and legal-hold bindings it holds on PACK-09's behalf - plus
# the additive codes it uses for its own audit bookkeeping, following the
# same pattern ADR-004/ADR-014/ADR-019/ADR-024 and PACK-07's, PACK-08's,
# PACK-09's and PACK-10's own registries already established. No PACK-11
# code path may use a free-text string in place of a registered code.
#
# This is a SEPARATE registry file from contracts/reason-codes/pack-02.yml
# through pack-10.yml (ADR-006 Option B precedent): codes several packs
# need (PERMISSION_DENIED, VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND) are independently
# redeclared here rather than imported from an earlier pack's file, so
# this file stays a complete, standalone source of truth for
# `document-service`'s own scan
# (`tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`'s PACK11_SERVICE_DIRS).
# `document-service` is a single, wholly new service - no existing
# PACK-02-through-PACK-10 service is extended in place this round - so,
# like PACK-08's, PACK-09's and PACK-10's files, there is no
# "shared with an earlier pack's service directory" union needed.
#
# **There are no `source: canon-0.8.0` entries in this file, and that is
# the notable thing about it.** Canon section 24 registers no document or
# evidence code at all: canon 19f.22 names PACK-11 as the owner of
# document bytes, authoritative versions, signatures, cryptographic
# version chains, evidence content and custody, but the canon round that
# would give the context its own section never happened. `CANON_VERSION`
# stays `0.8.0` here - this round amends no canon, it implements a
# context canon already assigned - so every DOCUMENT_* code below is an
# additive `source: pack-11-service` code justified in ADR-055, and each
# one says in its own `meaning` what it refuses and why no existing code
# expresses it.
#
# `source: pack-11-service` entries fall into two groups. Thirty-three are
# refusals. Twenty are `AuditEvent.reason_code` classifications for
# successfully-audited acts - canon's section-24 list is refusal-only and
# contains no code that means "this succeeded", which is the same gap
# ADR-004 recorded for PACK-02.
#
# `source: pack-0X-reused` entries are pre-existing generic codes reused
# verbatim (already registered in that pack's own file; independently
# redeclared here so this file stays complete). PACK-11 deliberately
# reuses rather than shadowing: retention and legal hold remain PACK-09's
# domain, organizational scope and authority remain PACK-08's, conflict of
# interest remains PACK-07's, and publication/disclosure control remains
# PACK-04's. A DOCUMENT_-prefixed duplicate of any of them would create
# two codes for one fact and let the two drift apart.
#
# Every entry carries the seven fields
# `epd2_core.reason_codes.ReasonCodeRegistry.load_from_yaml` requires
# (code, meaning, severity, description, retryable, owner,
# introduced_in_version); a missing field makes the whole registry fail to
# load.

# --- PACK-11 refusals (thirty-three) ---------------------------------

- code: DOCUMENT_ACCESS_PROFILE_INSUFFICIENT
  meaning: >-
    The presented access profile does not cover this material's
    sensitivity classification, or no profile was presented at all.
    A missing profile denies: the caller who forgot to present one
    is indistinguishable from the caller who has none.
  severity: error
  description: The access profile does not permit this material.
  retryable: false
  owner: document-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.11.0
  source: pack-11-service

- code: DOCUMENT_ALREADY_PUBLISHED
  meaning: >-
    A second publication of the same version was attempted. A
    republication is a new rendition of a new version, never a
    silent overwrite of the published one.
  severity: error
  description: This version is already published.
  retryable: false
  owner: document-service
  introduced_in_version: 0.11.0
  source: pack-11-service

- code: DOCUMENT_APPROVAL_MISSING
  meaning: >-

  description: No current approval exists for this version.
  retryable: false

  introduced_in_version: 0.11.0
  source: pack-11-service

===== FILE EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/contracts/reason-codes/pack-12.yml =====
# Centralized PACK-12 reason-code registry (Privileged Administration,
# Authorization-Aware Search & Governed Data Export; FIR-ROADMAP-002;
# ADR-061 through ADR-068).
#
# This is the single source of truth for every `reason_code` string
# literal introduced or used by the PACK-12 implementation candidate: the
# codes `privileged-access-service` raises for the privileged-access grant
# lifecycle, the governed break-glass workflow, tamper-evident privileged
# sessions, authorization-aware search, index policy, governed data export,
# DLP assessment and transforms, and statistical disclosure control - plus
# the additive codes it uses for its own audit bookkeeping, following the
# same pattern ADR-004/ADR-014/ADR-019/ADR-024/ADR-055 and PACK-07's
# through PACK-11's own registries already established. No PACK-12 code
# path may use a free-text string in place of a registered code, and no
# PACK-12 code path uses a generic `FORBIDDEN`.
#
# This is a SEPARATE registry file from contracts/reason-codes/pack-02.yml
# through pack-11.yml (ADR-006 Option B precedent): codes several packs
# need (PERMISSION_DENIED, VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND,
# ORGANIZATION_SCOPE_MISMATCH) are independently redeclared here rather
# than imported from an earlier pack's file, so this file stays a
# complete, standalone source of truth for `privileged-access-service`'s
# own scan (`tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`'s
# PACK12_SERVICE_DIRS). `privileged-access-service` is a single, wholly new
# service - no existing PACK-02-through-PACK-11 service is extended in
# place this round - so, like PACK-08's through PACK-11's files, there is
# no "shared with an earlier pack's service directory" union needed.
#
# **There are no `source: canon-0.8.0` entries in this file.** Canon
# section 24 registers no privileged-administration, search or export code
# at all: canon 19e assigns the privileged-access context but the canon
# round that would give it its own section never happened. `CANON_VERSION`
# stays `0.8.0` here - this round amends no canon, it implements a context
# canon already assigned - so every PRIVILEGE_*, SEARCH_*, EXPORT_* and
# DISCLOSURE_* code below is an additive `source: pack-12-service` code
# justified in ADR-061, and each one says in its own `meaning` what it
# refuses and why no existing code expresses it.
#
# The 141 entries fall into three groups. Ninety-eight are refusals raised
# by `epd2_privileged_access_service.exceptions`. Forty-three are
# `AuditEvent.reason_code` classifications for successfully-audited acts -
# canon's section-24 list is refusal-only and contains no code that means
# "this succeeded", which is the same gap ADR-004 recorded for PACK-02.
# Thirteen of the ninety-eight are pre-existing generic codes reused
# verbatim from an earlier pack (marked in their `owner`), because PACK-12
# deliberately reuses rather than shadowing: retention and legal hold
# remain PACK-09's, organizational scope and authority remain PACK-08's,
# and publication and disclosure control remain PACK-04's. A
# PRIVILEGE_-prefixed duplicate of any of them would create two codes for
# one fact and let the two drift apart.
#
# Every entry carries the seven fields
# `epd2_core.reason_codes.ReasonCodeRegistry.load_from_yaml` requires
# (code, meaning, severity, description, retryable, owner,
# introduced_in_version); a missing field makes the whole registry fail to
# load.

- code: AUTHORITY_ROLE_INCOMPATIBLE
  meaning: >-
    The candidate role_code conflicts with an existing active role_code
    already held by the same assigned_subject_reference in the same
    OrganizationalScope, per the role incompatibility baseline (canon
    19e.16, PAIRWISE_INCOMPATIBLE_ROLES).
  severity: error
  description: This role cannot be combined with a role you already hold in this scope.
  retryable: false
  owner: organization-service

    temporary-supervision/institutional-oversight-without-data-access)
    and found no grant covering the requested (actor_scope,
    target_scope, action_code) triple - the engine's default is deny.
  severity: error

  retryable: false

===== FILE EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/contracts/reason-codes/pack-13.yml =====
# Centralized PACK-13 reason-code registry (Production Data Plane &
# Contract Evolution; FIR-ROADMAP-003; ADR-069 through ADR-078).
#
# This is the single source of truth for every `reason_code` string
# literal introduced or used by the PACK-13 implementation candidate: the
# codes `data-plane-service` raises for the canonical schema registry and
# contract evolution, migration control, backfill, optimistic concurrency
# and idempotency, outbox and delivery semantics, projection governance,
# and the structural data-plane boundary refusals - plus the additive
# `*_RECORDED` classifications it uses for its own audit bookkeeping,
# following the same pattern ADR-004/ADR-014/ADR-019/ADR-024/ADR-055 and
# PACK-07's through PACK-12's own registries already established. No
# PACK-13 code path may use a free-text string in place of a registered
# code.
#
# Two prohibitions from the PACK-13 reason-code catalog shape this file
# and are worth stating where a future contributor will read them:
#
#   `P13-RSN-002` - there is NO generic `DATA_ERROR` and NO generic
#   `CONFLICT` in this registry, and none may be added. A single code for
#   many causes is a code that tells an operator nothing and an auditor
#   less. Where two failures differ in what an operator must do next,
#   they are two codes.
#
#   `P13-RSN-004` - a code's meaning never changes (`P13-API-007`). A new
#   meaning is a new code. Editing a `meaning` field below to cover a
#   further case is exactly the silent semantic change ADR-074 forbids.
#
# This is a SEPARATE registry file from contracts/reason-codes/pack-02.yml
# through pack-12.yml (ADR-006 Option B precedent): codes several packs
# need (PERMISSION_DENIED, VALIDATION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND,
# ORGANIZATION_SCOPE_MISMATCH, RECORD_UNDER_LEGAL_HOLD and the rest of
# the reused set in section 9 of the PACK-13 catalog) are independently
# redeclared here rather than imported from an earlier pack's file, so
# this file stays a complete, standalone source of truth for
# `data-plane-service`'s own scan
# (`tests/contract/test_reason_codes_registry.py`'s PACK13_SERVICE_DIRS).
# `data-plane-service` is a single, wholly new service - no existing
# PACK-02-through-PACK-12 service is extended in place this round - so,
# like PACK-08's through PACK-12's files, there is no "shared with an
# earlier pack's service directory" union needed.
#
# Each redeclared entry keeps its ORIGINAL owning pack's meaning and
# names that owner in `owner` (`P13-RSN-005`): one fact keeps one code,
# and PACK-13 shadows none of them with a prefixed duplicate.
#
# **There are no `source: canon-0.8.0` entries in this file.** Canon
# section 24 registers no data-plane, schema-registry, migration or
# delivery code at all: the canon has no data-plane section, and this
# round amends no canon - `CANON_VERSION` stays `0.8.0`. Every SCHEMA_*,
# MIGRATION_*, BACKFILL_*, CONCURRENCY_*, IDEMPOTENCY_*, EVENT_*,
# OUTBOX_*, DELIVERY_*, BROKER_*, PROJECTION_* and DATAPLANE_* code below
# is an additive `pack-13-service` code justified in ADR-069 through
# ADR-078, and each one says in its own `meaning` what it refuses and why
# no existing code expresses it.
#
# The 125 entries fall into two groups. Eighty-eight are the codes the
# PACK-13 Reason Code Catalog specifies (sections 2 through 9 of that
# document: 78 additive plus 10 reused). Thirty-seven are the
# `*_RECORDED` classifications `P13-RSN-006` requires - canon section 24
# is refusal-only, and an act that SUCCEEDS still needs a registered
# classification for its audit row, which is the same gap ADR-004
# recorded for PACK-02. There is exactly one per event in the PACK-13
# Event Catalog, derived mechanically from the event name by
# `epd2_data_plane_service.events.recorded_reason_code_for`, so the two
# can never drift apart.

# --- Additive PACK-13 codes (78) -------------------------------------------

- code: SCHEMA_INCOMPATIBLE
  meaning: >-
    The proposed schema version is incompatible under the family's
    declared compatibility mode. Distinct from
    SCHEMA_COMPATIBILITY_UNKNOWN, which says the checker could not decide:
    this code says it decided, and the answer was no.
  severity: error
  description: The proposed version is incompatible under the declared mode.
  retryable: false
  owner: data-plane-service (PACK-13)
  introduced_in_version: pack-13-0.13.0

- code: SCHEMA_COMPATIBILITY_UNKNOWN
  meaning: >-
    The compatibility checker could not classify the change, so it is
    unknown and requires manual review (P13-COMPAT-002). Unknown is a
    first-class outcome and is never collapsed into 'probably compatible'.
  severity: error
  description: The checker could not classify the change; manual review is required.
  retryable: false
  owner: data-plane-service (PACK-13)
  introduced_in_version: pack-13-0.13.0

- code: SCHEMA_OWNER_MISSING
  meaning: >-
    A schema was submitted with no registered owning domain, so
    publication is refused (P13-REG-007). A platform team can maintain a
    file; only the domain knows what a change means.
  severity: error
  description: No registered owner; publication refused.
  retryable: false
  owner: data-plane-service (PACK-13)
  introduced_in_version: pack-13-0.13.0

- code: SCHEMA_NOT_APPROVED
  meaning: >-
    Activation was attempted for a version that has not been approved, or
    that is in a lifecycle state from which no version serves traffic.
  severity: error
  description: Activation attempted before approval.
  retryable: false
  owner: data-plane-service (PACK-13)
  introduced_in_version: pack-13-0.13.0

- code: SCHEMA_DIGEST_MISMATCH
  meaning: >-
    The submitted content does not match the recorded content_digest, or a
    digest was compared across two different formats.
  severity: error
  description: The content does not match the recorded content digest.
  retryable: false
  owner: data-plane-service (PACK-13)
  introduced_in_version: pack-13-0.13.0

- code: SCHEMA_DUPLICATE_CONTENT
  meaning: >-
    Content identical to a registered version after that format's own
    canonicalization was submitted without an intentional-republication
    declaration; the accidental republication is blocked (P13-REG-005d).
    It is never silently accepted and never silently deduplicated into the
    existing version.
  severity: error
  description: Accidental republication of identical content is blocked.
  retryable: false
  owner: data-plane-service (PACK-13)
  introduced_in_version: pack-13-0.13.0

- code: SCHEMA_DUPLICATE_CONTENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED
  meaning: >-
    Identical content was deliberately submitted as a new version but
    carries no governance_justification, so the submission goes to reason-
    coded review. Wanting a new version is not itself a reason for one.
  severity: error
  description: Identical content submitted as a new version without a justification.
  retryable: false
  owner: data-plane-service (PACK-13)
  introduced_in_version: pack-13-0.13.0

- code: SCHEMA_IDENTICAL_CONTENT_REPUBLICATION_APPROVED
  meaning: >-
    Identical content was deliberately bound to a new governed version
    with its justification recorded (P13-REG-005e) - a re-issue under a
    changed compatibility mode, a new effective date, a corrected
    ownership assignment, or a republication after a governance defect.
    Registered as an outcome, not a refusal, because it classifies an
    approved act.
  severity: info
  description: Identical content deliberately bound to a new governed version.
  retryable: false
  owner: data-plane-service (PACK-13)
  introduced_in_version: pack-13-0.13.0

- code: SCHEMA_VERSION_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE
  meaning: >-
    An attempt was made to re-point, merge or rewrite a historical
    schema_version_id because of digest equality (P13-REG-005g). A
    version's identity is established by its own publication decision and
    a later publication does not retroactively alter it.
  severity: error
  description: A historical schema version identity is never rewritten.
  retryable: false
  owner: data-plane-service (PACK-13)
  introduced_in_version: pack-13-0.13.0

# --- `*_RECORDED` audit classifications (37) --------------------------------

# `P13-RSN-006`: canon section 24 is refusal-only, and an act that SUCCEEDS
# still needs a registered classification for its audit row - the same gap
# ADR-004 recorded for PACK-02. Exactly one per event in the PACK-13 Event
# Catalog, derived from the event name by
# `epd2_data_plane_service.events.recorded_reason_code_for`, so the two can
# never drift. Each classifies a successful, audited act; none is a refusal,
# and none is retryable, because a completed act is not retried.

===== FILE EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/docs/adr/ADR-044-shared-frontend-source-runtime-isolation.md =====
# ADR-044: Shared frontend source with runtime workspace isolation

- Status: Proposed
- Date: 2026-07-27

Share presentational source components while retaining ten independent origin,
session, navigation and storage contexts. Shared source must never become a
shared runtime identity/session layer.


===== FILE EPD2_CTRL02_REGIONAL_INTERVENTION_AND_PRIVILEGED_OPERATIONS_WORKING_0.1_PRESEAL/docs/adr/ADR-045-existing-visual-baseline-preservation.md =====
# ADR-045: Preserve the existing EPD frontend visual baseline

- Status: Proposed
- Date: 2026-07-27

Treat `EPD_Front.zip` and its `core.css` as the visual baseline. Normalize tokens
and accessibility behavior without replacing institutional minimalism or branding.

CTRL02_DISCOVERY_PASS
